startingCard.title: Arsenal F.C. is founded
startingCard.subtitle: Football club
startingCard.fact: The Arsenal Football Club is an English professional football club based in Islington, North London, England.

cards.title: ‘Lemon8’ launches
cards.subtitle: Social networking service
cards.fact: Lemon8 is a social media app owned by Heliophilia Pte.

cards.title: ‘Clockwork Angels’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Rush
cards.fact: Clockwork Angels is the nineteenth and final studio album by Canadian rock band Rush, released on June 8, 2012, on Roadrunner Records.

cards.title: ‘Another’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Yukito Ayatsuji
cards.fact: Another is a Japanese mystery horror novel by Yukito Ayatsuji, published on October 29, 2009, by Kadokawa Shoten.

cards.title: Qutuz becomes Mamluk sultan
cards.fact: Sayf ad-Din Qutuz, also romanized as Kutuz or Kotuz and fully al-Malik al-Muẓaffar Sayf ad-Dīn Quṭuz, was the Mamluk Sultan of Egypt.

cards.title: ‘Lost Girls’ is published
cards.subtitle: Graphic novel by Alan Moore
cards.fact: Lost Girls is a graphic novel written by Alan Moore and illustrated by Melinda Gebbie, depicting the sexually explicit adventures of three female fictional characters of the late 19th and early 20th century: Alice from Lewis Carroll's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and Through the Looking-Glass, Dorothy Gale from L.

cards.title: Caligula becomes Roman emperor
cards.fact: Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, also called Gaius and Caligula, was the third Roman emperor, ruling from AD 37 until his assassination in AD 41.

cards.title: ‘EFootball’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Konami
cards.fact: eFootball is a 2021 association football video game developed, published, and updated annually by Konami.

cards.title: Mars Polar Lander launches
cards.subtitle: Mission by National Aeronautics and Space Administration
cards.fact: The Mars Polar Lander, also known as the Mars Surveyor '98 Lander, was a 290-kilogram uncrewed spacecraft lander launched by NASA on January 3, 1999, to study the soil and climate of Planum Australe, a region near the south pole on Mars.

cards.title: Mi-10 first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Rostvertol
cards.fact: The Mil Mi-10, given the product number izdeliye 60, is a Soviet military transport helicopter of flying crane configuration, developed from the Mi-6, entering service in 1963.

cards.title: ‘Eternals’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Chloé Zhao
cards.fact: Eternals is a 2021 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics race the Eternals.

cards.title: Valentinian I becomes Roman emperor
cards.fact: Valentinian I, sometimes known as Valentinian the Great, was Roman emperor from 364 to 375.

cards.title: Soyuz MS-28 launches
cards.subtitle: Space mission
cards.fact: Soyuz MS-28, identified by NASA as Soyuz 74S, is a Russian crewed Soyuz spaceflight launched from Site 31/6 at the Baikonur Cosmodrome on 27 November 2025 to the International Space Station, where it docked to Russia's Rassvet docking port.

cards.title: Moon Jae-in becomes president of South Korea
cards.fact: Moon Jae-in is a South Korean politician and lawyer who served as the 12th president of South Korea from 2017 to 2022.

cards.title: ‘Echo of Moscow’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: Echo of Moscow was a 24/7 commercial Russian radio station based in Moscow.

cards.title: The Pizza Company is founded
cards.subtitle: Thai restaurant chain
cards.fact: The Pizza Company is a Thai multinational pizza restaurant chain and international franchise founded in 1980 in Bangkok, Thailand, by William Heinecke.

cards.title: Qajar dynasty begins
cards.subtitle: Dynasty
cards.fact: The Qajar dynasty is a formerly aristocratic Iranian dynasty that gained prominence with the rise of Shahverdi Sultan in the early 16th century as heads of the Turkoman Qajar tribe of the Qizilbash confederacy.

cards.title: ‘The Bear’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American comedy television series
cards.fact: The Bear is an American comedy-drama television series created by Christopher Storer for FX on Hulu.

cards.title: Cary Grant dies
cards.subtitle: British-American actor
cards.fact: Cary Grant was an English-American actor.

cards.title: Joan Crawford dies
cards.subtitle: American actress
cards.fact: Joan Crawford was an American actress.

cards.title: Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino is completed
cards.subtitle: Casino resort in Las Vegas, Nevada
cards.fact: The Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino is a hotel, casino, and timeshare resort in Winchester, Nevada.

cards.title: Hieronymus Bosch dies
cards.subtitle: Dutch painter
cards.fact: Hieronymus Bosch was a Dutch painter from Brabant.

cards.title: ‘Final Fantasy VI’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Square
cards.fact: Final Fantasy VI, titled Final Fantasy III in its initial North American release, is a 1994 role-playing video game developed and published by Square for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System.

cards.title: ‘Cars 3’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Brian Fee
cards.fact: Cars 3 is a 2017 American animated sports comedy-adventure film produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures.

cards.title: Burj Khalifa is completed
cards.subtitle: Skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
cards.fact: The Burj Khalifa is a megatall skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

cards.title: ‘Mission: Impossible – Ghost Protocol’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Brad Bird
cards.fact: Mission: Impossible – Ghost Protocol is a 2011 American action spy film directed by Brad Bird from a screenplay by the writing team of Josh Appelbaum and André Nemec, who also serve as co-producers.

cards.title: ‘Sense and Sensibility’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Ang Lee
cards.fact: Sense and Sensibility is a 1995 American period drama film directed by Ang Lee and based on Jane Austen's 1811 novel of the same name.

cards.title: ‘Mortal Kombat’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by NetherRealm Studios
cards.fact: Mortal Kombat is a 2011 fighting game developed by NetherRealm Studios and published by Warner Bros.

cards.title: Liz Truss becomes prime minister of the United Kingdom
cards.fact: Mary Elizabeth Truss is a British politician who was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Conservative Party from September to October 2022.

cards.title: Edward VII becomes king of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
cards.fact: Edward VII was King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Emperor of India, from 22 January 1901 until his death in 1910.

cards.title: ‘Chicago Fire’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American drama television series
cards.fact: Chicago Fire is an American procedural drama series broadcast by NBC.
